ns2:section.sectionText: This course will open to all students in the Gies College of Business on Monday, November 15, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This course will open to Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering, Systems Engineering & Design and French Commercial students on Monday, November 22, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to all of campus to allow Business Minor and prospective Business Minor students the option to register for this elective not offered as an online option on Monday, November 29, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m.
